'''Jori Lekauf''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|secret police]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. The grandson of [[Erv Lekauf]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] command, Jori followed his grandfather's example by serving with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]&mdash;Vader's grandson, a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Guard. Following the formation of the Guard, Lekauf served with the [[967 Commando]], a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] GAG [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] who served under Solo's direct command.

Lekauf rose through the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] of the Guard, having been promoted from [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] during his service in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Noted for his optimistic outlook, he befriended the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ben Skywalker]], Vader's other grandson who also served as an officer in the Guard. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] Lekauf [[Death/Legends|sacrificed]] his life on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]] in order to complete a GAG [[Mission to Vulpter|mission]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lekauf.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jori Lekauf was the grandson of Erv Lekauf, an Imperial officer loyal to Darth Vader.]]
Jori was the grandson of [[Erv Lekauf]], who served under [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] command. He looked up to his grandfather more so than he did his own parents. Jori opted to follow in his grandfather's footsteps and became a Corporal in the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], serving under Vader's own grandson, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. Jori was fiercely loyal to Solo, though at times, he often questioned the nature of his decisions.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

During one GAG raid on Coruscant, Lekauf befriended [[Ben Skywalker]], Jacen's cousin and informal apprentice. Lekauf offered to help Ben get over his first combat kill. They grew very close as Ben considered him to be one of his best friends.<ref name="Bloodlines" />

Shortly after being commissioned Lieutenant, Jori was tasked with leading a small group of GAG personnel to [[Vulpter/Legends|Vulpter]], where they were to monitor the meeting between [[Five World Prime Minister|Prime Minister]] [[Dur Gejjen]] and [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Cal Omas]]. To prepare Ben for his role in the mission, Jori insisted on having a hand in Ben's combat training. Within a day, he managed to turn Skywalker into an efficient [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]], though the boy had his doubts about killing Gejjen in cold blood.<ref name="Sacrifice 2" /> Although their mission was a success, it was not a clean getaway; as Jori and Ben tried to escape security locked down the entire spaceport. Realizing that they would be caught, Lekauf took the sniper rifle from Ben, used a hostage to bluff his way out of the terminal (all the while shouting that he was a Corellian patriot opposed to the GA), and then managed to board their ship. Jori then [[Death/Legends|self-destructed the ship]] so that security would believe the killer was already dead and Ben would go free.<ref name="Sacrifice 1" />
